episodes.name: Spider-Man & Iron Man In... Training Day, Part 1
episodes.overviewEn: After Spider-Man stops some crooks from robbing a Stark Enterprises facility, Iron Man decides to pay him back with some on the job training.

episodes.name: Spider-Man & Iron Man In... Training Day, Part 2
episodes.overviewEn: Villainous Batroc the Leaper returns with new powers.

episodes.name: Spider-Man & Iron Man In... Training Day, Part 3
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man and Iron Man soon realize they are going to have to learn some new tricks if they’re going to be able to defeat Batroc 2.0.

episodes.name: Black Panther in... The Visitor
episodes.overviewEn: Black Panther gets a visit from Everett K. Ross to discuss security for a possible international summit in Wakanda. The visit is unexpectedly interrupted by super-villain, Ghost.
